title: Route & Model Cost/Latency Conflation Service
creator: Priya Shah
description: Build a streaming + batch service that conflates telemetry (token traces, KV cache metadata, batching windows, infra metrics) with route and model metadata to produce per-route / per-model / per-customer cost and latency breakdowns. Outputs will feed the Console dashboards (real-time and historical), billing attributions, and anomaly detectors. The service must handle late-arriving events, be idempotent by request_id, and provide both granular (per-request) and rolled-up (minute/hour/day) views.
acceptance_criteria: Produces per-route/per-model/per-customer rollups updated within 60s for 95% of requests
Per-request attribution fields present for >= 99.9% of requests (request_id mapped)
End-to-end tests validating cost attribution math against canonical simulator (accuracy within +/-2%)
Supports replay of 7 days of raw telemetry to recompute historical attributions
Schema and tables documented; downstream consumers (Console, billing jobs, anomaly-detector) validated
design_decisions: Use an event-driven pipeline: Apache Beam (Dataflow) for streaming joins and watermarking; batch recompute in BigQuery for historical re-materialization
Store real-time rollups in ClickHouse for sub-1s dashboard queries and write canonical daily tables to BigQuery
Deduplicate by request_id at the ingestion layer. Use request_id + event_type + seq to detect partial replays
Attribute cost by GPU-second per-token where inference_time is available; fall back to model-family token weight table when only token counts are present
Latency decomposition: queue_time, scheduling_time, inference_time, postproc_time. If component timing missing, mark as 'partial' and surface in quality metrics
implementation_plan: Phase 0: Prototype Beam pipeline joining token-traces (kafka.topic=telemetry.tokens) with route metadata (stores: config-service) and model-profiles (model-catalog). Produce sample minute rollups to ClickHouse - 2 weeks
Phase 1: Harden at-scale: watermark strategy (max_lateness=15m), dedupe store (redis LRU with TTL=24h), metric instrumentation, CI - 3 weeks
Phase 2: Backfill & reconciliation job in BigQuery with config-driven transforms; export canonical daily tables and add sanity-check reconciler - 2 weeks
Phase 3: Integrate with Console endpoints and billing ingestion; finalize rollout and on-call runbook - 2 weeks
data_schema: per_request_attribution: request_id, timestamp, customer_id, route_id, model_hash, region, tokens_in, tokens_out, kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_misses, batch_size, queue_time_ms, schedule_time_ms, inference_time_ms, postproc_time_ms, total_latency_ms, cost_usd_estimate, flags:partial_attribution
minute_rollup: minute_bucket, customer_id, route_id, model_family, total_tokens_in, total_tokens_out, avg_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, cost_usd, kv_miss_rate
daily_canonical: date, customer_id, route_id, model_family, cost_usd_billed, compute_usd_estimated, storage_usd, misc_usd, reconciliation_status
attribution_algorithm: If per-request component timings present: cost = sum(component_gpu_seconds * gpu_rate) where component_gpu_seconds derived from inference_time_ms and model_gflops_profile

Latency split: queue/schedule/inference/postproc as reported. If missing components, estimate inference_time = total_latency - (median_queue+median_schedule+median_postproc) for that route over 1h window
KV cache impact: attribute incremental compute cost only to tokens with cache_miss=true; mark cached tokens with zero incremental model_compute_cost
observability: Dashboards: real-time ClickHouse panels (last 1h) and BigQuery historical panel (last 90d) showing per-route cost and latency breakdown
SLOs: freshness <60s (95pct), completeness of mapping (request_id mapped) > 99.9%, attribution-accuracy within +/-2% compared to simulator
Tracing: link request_id to distributed traces; surface top offenders in console with example traces
rollout_plan: Canary: enable for internal beta customers (10% of traffic) and Console internal orgs; monitor correctness and cost delta vs legacy estimator for 48h
Ramp: 25% after safety check (automated validation passes), then 50%, 100% over 7 days
Fallback: feature flag to switch back to legacy estimator; pipeline supports dual-write of legacy and new rollups during ramp
Post-rollout: 30-day observation window and automated backfill to validate parity with billing anchor
risks_and_mitigations: Late-arriving telemetry could skew minute rollups — mitigation: keep 15m watermark with materialized re-writes and mark corrected buckets
Model profile drift (new model variants without profile) — mitigation: default family weights and nightly auto-profiling job to update model_gflops_profile
High cardinality explosion for route+model+customer combinations — mitigation: configurable aggregation window and TTL for low-volume keys, sample fallback
Cost estimation variance — mitigation: calibration runs against reserved-capacity job-level chargebacks and reconcile weekly
tasks: ENG: implement Beam joins and dedupe logic (Ethan)
ENG: ClickHouse real-time schema and ingestion (backend infra)
ENG: BigQuery backfill templates and reconciliation (data-platform)
PM: coordinate Console feature flags and dashboard requirements (Priya)
